summary_en: This study tests a decision tool that sorts women having radical cystectomy for bladder urothelial carcinoma into "favorable" or "unfavorable" groups. Women in the favorable group have a reproductive organ sparing radical cystectomy, and women in the unfavorable group have a standard radical cystectomy; how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa una herramienta de decisión que clasifica a mujeres que se someterán a una cistectomía radical por carcinoma urotelial de vejiga en los grupos "favorable" o "desfavorable". Las mujeres del grupo favorable reciben una cistectomía radical que conserva los órganos reproductivos, y las del grupo desfavorable reciben una cistectomía radical estándar; la duración o frecuencia no se indica. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; se trata de un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Adult women aged 18 or older with histologically proven urothelial carcinoma of the bladder
Able to have a pelvic MRI that meets the stated minimum standards
At least one of: anterior vagina, uterus, fallopian tubes, or ovaries present
not_for: Other known active malignancies that may confound recurrence rates
Known germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutation
